objective: Review decision to retain mutmut based on operational evidence from M45 qualification

evidence: 6 campaigns executed: 4 successful, 2 timeout (due to runtime constraints, not backend crashes)
Process cleanup works via signal handlers

result_integrity.description: Correctness and completeness of mutation results
evidence: All campaigns produce valid mutation counts
Result classification is consistent and correct

determinism.description: Reproducibility of results under identical conditions
evidence: account_engine campaign run twice: identical results
Mutation population, classification, scores all identical

syntax_coverage.description: Ability to handle Python syntax and generate mutations
evidence: Handles complex expressions and control structures
Generates mutations for arithmetic, control flow, comparison, boolean operators
Survivor catalog shows diverse mutation types
syntax_coverage.notes: Some Python 3.12+ syntax may be skipped (L-ARCH-001)

import_correctness.description: Correct handling of Python imports and module structure
evidence: src. namespace imports handled via conftest.py shim
Mutation generation works across all tested engines
Test selection correctly maps to mutated modules

timeout_behaviour.description: Proper handling of timeouts and long-running operations
evidence: Timeouts are detected and classified as INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE
Process groups are properly terminated on timeout
Clean exit with explicit error messages
timeout_behaviour.notes: Some campaigns timeout due to performance, not backend issues

evidence: No worker crashes or corruption observed

reproducibility.description: Ability to reproduce results across different runs and environments
evidence: Results consistent between local and expected CI execution

performance.notes: Performance varies by component complexity; some engines timeout locally

ci_operation.description: Compatibility and reliability in CI environment
evidence: CI workflows use canonical verify.py mutation path
Cache validation works in CI context
Timeout handling appropriate for CI constraints
ci_operation.notes: CI qualification (M45.9) will provide full validation

l_arch_001_python_312_syntax.description: mutmut silently skips some Python 3.12+ syntax
l_arch_001_python_312_syntax.impact: Quantified by M45.14 L-ARCH-001 probe — production code uses PEP 604 union annotations (586 occurrences in 139/242 files). Mutmut 3.7.0 generates mutations for PEP 604, PEP 634 match, PEP 654 except*, and PEP 695 type-parameter syntax in the probe.

risk_assessment.mitigation_available: M45.14 probe quantifies population per syntax feature

l_arch_001_python_312_syntax.recommendation: RESOLVED — L-ARCH-001 has been investigated. mutmut 3.7.0 generates mutations for every Python syntax feature used in ClariFin_OS production code. No silent population gaps detected.

evidence: All generated mutants have canonical IDs
gaps_identified: Some engines timeout before completion (performance issue, not population issue)

silent_omission_risk.impact: Mutation score may appear higher than actual code coverage
silent_omission_risk.mitigation: Static analysis cross-reference, explicit syntax testing

limitations: Some performance issues with larger engines (deferred to CI per M45.22)

justification: Architecture properly isolates backend as implementation detail
L-ARCH-001 limitation investigated and resolved — no silent population gaps for used syntax
Migration to alternative backend would be costly and disruptive
conditions: Mutation population completeness must continue to be monitored via the M45.14 probe
Cache validation must remain in place to prevent stale evidence
decision.replacement_trigger: If a future production code change introduces syntax that mutmut 3.7.0 cannot mutate AND the population gap exceeds 5% of mutants

action_items.action: Monitor L-ARCH-001 surface via the M45.14 probe in subsequent CI campaigns
Re-run L-ARCH-001 probe if production code introduces PEP 634 / PEP 654 / PEP 695 syntax
